grc:name:Καδμῖλος.html:
Καδμῖλος (on the accent v. Hdn.Gr.), ὁ, name of one of the Cabiri in Samothrace,
s.v.Καβειρία, Hdn.Gr.:— also Κασμ-, Dionysodor. ap. , cf. (Imbros, ii A.D.), ; identified with Hermes, ibid., Hdn.Gr., Sch.: with Lat. camillus (casm-), Varr., cf. ; Καδμῖλοι is prob. for Κάδωλοι, title of ministrants in the cult of the Curetes and Μεγάλοι Θεοί, .
